field.$description: Shared tokens for every form control (TextField, SearchField, Select, Checkbox): label, hint, error, control border and sizes. One set, so form controls can't drift apart again. Evidence: audit families F08 text field (177 instances, 5 shapes), F19 search field, F11 select, F09 checkbox.

gap.$description: PROPOSED: 4px between label, control and hint.

font-size.$description: PROPOSED: 14px hints and errors; caption (12px) is too small for instructions people need.

color.$description: PROPOSED: darker error red with an icon and a message (decision 7), 7.37:1.

icon-size.$description: PROPOSED: error icon beside the message.

radius.$description: OBSERVED: 4px fields; absorbs the observed 2px grey-outlined field (108 instances).

pill-radius.$description: OBSERVED: pill fields (40 and 48px). Kept only for the hero location search, as the brief proposes.

border-width-invalid.$description: PROPOSED: a thicker border when invalid, so the error isn't shown by colour alone (with the icon and message).

gap.$description: PROPOSED: space between text and an end action (clear, submit).

height.$description: OBSERVED: 38 and 40px fields; became 40px for the 4px grid.

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 16px. Also stops iOS zooming in on focus (it zooms below 16px).

default.$description: OBSERVED: white fields. Absorbs the grey-filled #f3f3f3 field.

read-only.$description: PROPOSED: grey for read-only values. Not observed.

placeholder.$description: PROPOSED: placeholder at 5.77:1, so it's readable; never a substitute for the label.

background.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's clear button is a filled dark circle with a white cross.

icon.$description: OBSERVED: white cross on the dark circle.

clear-size.$description: PROPOSED: the clear button's target, the 24px minimum (WCAG 2.5.8).

clear-icon-size.$description: PROPOSED: the filled circle inside it.

start-icon-size.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's location arrow at the start of the results search (a phone screenshot, 2026-10-11).

start-icon-color.$description: OBSERVED: the location arrow in ink.

search-icon-size.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's results search ends in a plain dark blue magnifier, not a filled button (a phone screenshot).

search-icon-color.$description: OBSERVED: the magnifier in AcmeCo dark blue (#123a7a, 10.98:1 on white).
